message.industry-made.boiler_water_full: The boiler is already full of water.
message.industry-made.crucible_no_molten: The crucible has no molten metal to pour.
tooltip.industry-made.bellows: Manual draft pump. Injects oxygen blasts into crucibles and boilers.
tooltip.industry-made.bronze_gauge_pipe: Analog dial pressure gauge. Right-click to read exact bar pressure.
tooltip.industry-made.bronze_gear: Heavy bronze gear for mechanical drives and power trains.
tooltip.industry-made.bronze_ingot: Durable, corrosion-resistant alloy for steam machinery and tools.
tooltip.industry-made.bronze_pickaxe: Mining pick capable of extracting all iron-tier ores.
tooltip.industry-made.bronze_plate: Heavy bronze plate for boiler shells, pistons, and machinery.
tooltip.industry-made.bronze_rod: Machined bronze structural rod for shafts and valve stems.
tooltip.industry-made.bronze_shovel: Heavy bronze spade for fast earth excavation.
tooltip.industry-made.bronze_steam_pipe: Transports pressurized steam between boilers, valves, and machines.
tooltip.industry-made.bronze_sword: Corrosion-resistant alloy sword with extended durability.
tooltip.industry-made.bronze_valve_pipe: Controls steam flow. Right-click to toggle open or closed.
tooltip.industry-made.ceramic_mold: Fired ceramic mold. Right-click a crucible with molten metal to cast.
tooltip.industry-made.clay_mold: Unfired clay ingot mold. Must be fired in a furnace before use.
